owner: existing planned-action guard triggers config and one test; no new mechanism
root_cause: The DO_NOT_AUTO_FIX_PERFORMANCE_INFO trigger shipped in #5508 went through two defects. A first version used the bare word 'advisor' and fired on 'strategic advisor' (#5212); that near-miss was caught only by a one-off replay of 400 commit titles outside CI. Pinning it as a test then exposed the opposite defect: the action words only contained 'drop index', so 'Drop the unused index reported by the Supabase advisor' was not matched.
prevention_rule: A required-check test pins three real commit titles containing 'advisor' as hard negatives and three genuine Supabase advisor actions as positives, with a mutation check that fails against the original bare-word trigger. The action words of this one rule were widened (drop, add an index, adding an index, add index, resolve) while the system terms stay specific. Examples are hand-picked; recall across the 19 wave4 rules remains NOT_MEASURED and belongs to #5510.
